id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying syncs after a 410 gone response

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies Datadog warehouse ingestion behavior: distinguishes between transient and permanent data loss, preventing unnecessary retry loops for expired retention windows.
review.reason: Adds a new non-retryable error status (410 Gone) and its description, and updates tests to cover this status. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for the warehouse ingestion path.
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and whether this prevents real-world retry storms or customer confusion is not independently verified; the benefit relies on the implementation and test changes being deployed and effective.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error status and its description.
observations.code_quote: "410 Client Error: Gone": "The requested Datadog data has fallen outside your account's retention window, or its pagination cursor expired. Retry the sync to start a fresh query.",
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that a 410 Gone response from Datadog indicates retained data has expired, requiring a fresh query rather than a retry, and this behavior is now documented and tested.

observations.behavior: Updates the test parametrization to include the new error status.
